tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i sbyin sreg gi phyag len rab tu gsal ba 'phrin las lhun grub ces bya ba bzhugs// shrī badzra ku ma ra mahā badzra ā tsarya ye na mo/ bla ma mchog dang rdo rje gzhon nu la/ /gus pas btud de dpal ldan phur pa yi/ /sbyin sreg cho ga phyag len rab gsal ba/ /'phrin las lhun grub lhag bsam dag pas spel/ /'dir dpal rdo rje phur pa sa lugs kyi bsnyen pa sngon du song ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg sgrub pa la don gsum ste/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi cho ga'o/ /dang po ni/ sbyor ba thabs dang / bud shing sbar ba me/ /rdzas dang bsham thabs sgrub pa po ste drug ces pa ltar las/ dang po thab ni/ nyams dga' zhing sa'i cho ga byas pa'i sa phyogs su thig chen brgyad spyi dang mthun par btab pa la/ khru phyed kyi dbus nas zlum por bskor ba ni thab kyi dngos gzhi dang / de'i phyi rol tu sor bzhi bskor ba kha khyer dang slar yang sor bzhi bskor ba mu ran dang / tshad de nyid kyis tshangs thig dang mu ran 'dzoms pa'i sa nas zur thig bzhi'i steng du mtshan ma byas la/ thig bzhi legs par sbrel ba'i steng du gru bzhi dang / de'i grwa bzhir rdo rje'i rtse nang ngos su bstan pa'i zla phyed rdo rje bya/ phyag len la stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i phyi rol tu'ang sor bzhi'i tshad kyi cha ga gru bzhi pa mdzad pa ni bri cha la mig sngar mdzes pa dang / bsgom don la stegs bu'i dpangs kyi tshad yin gsungs/ thab kyi dbus nas sum gnyis phyir bzhag pa'i nang gi sum cha zlum por bskor ba'i dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa'i lte ba dang / phyi'i sum gnyis la 'khor lo'i rtsibs bcu pa rnams bya/ thab kyi gzhi thams cad kha dog dkar por bya/ kha khyer ram mu ran gang rung la rdo rje kha zum pa'i phreng bas bskor ba/ kha dog 'dres pa'i skyon spangs pa'i phyir bcad tshon thams cad dang rdo rje kha dog dmar skyas bya/

lha'i gnas rnams su me tog gi tshom bu'am so so'i sku mdog dang mthun pa'i tshon phung bya/ 'khor lo'i phyi thab kyi nang du sgo ma bzhi'i tshon phung bkod/ gzhan yang gtso bo'i zhal 'jig rten pa'i nub tu bstan pa'i mdun g.yas ngos su hūm̐ ka ra'i mtshan ma byas la/ de'i rigs pas gzhan rnams kyi phyogs mtshams kyang shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa bud shing ni/ tsher ma can ma yin pa'i shing ngam/ de med na srog chags med pa'i lci bas thab kyi kha khyer gyi steng nas zlum por brtsigs la/ nang gi shar lho'i mtshams su ting lo che ba zhig kyang bshams la bzhag go /gsum pa sbar ba ni/ rdo dang lcags gtsubs pa las byung ba ma yin pa/ rgyun bzhag gi me'am 'o ma can gtsubs pa sogs las byung ba'o/ /bzhi pa rdzas ni/ sreg rdzas dang / mchod rdzas dang / gtor ma dang / ku sha'i chun po la sogs pa 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams gtsang zhing gya nom pa sta gon bya'o/ /lnga pa bsham thabs ni/ thab kyi mtha' skor thams cad byi dor legs par byas la dri bzang pos byugs/ de'i mdun du rang gi stan nang tshangs can kha dog dkar po bya/ rang gi g.yon thab kyi g.yas nas chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dang / gtor ma gsum ji ltar 'byor ba bsham/ rang gi g.yas thab kyi g.yon nas/ yam shing mar til zas mchog dang / /so ba 'bras nas gro dang ni/ /sran ma dur ba ku sha rnams/ /lag len ji bzhin legs par bsham/ /rang gi mdun du bsang chu'i snod/ ku sha'i 'thor yab/ rdo rje dril bu/ nang gi mchod pa rnams bsham/ rdo rje dril bu'i bar du dgang gzar blugs gzar kha sbyar la bzhag so sor bzhag na bar chad kyi chos yin gsung / grub na thab dang sgrub pa po'i bar du 'jim pa las byas pa'i me yol dkar zhal gyis byugs pa'ang bshams la/ rdzas thams cad la bdud rtsi lngas gtor te bzhag go /drug pa sgrub pa po ni/ phyi ma red kyi dus su rang nyid khrus byas/

'byor na gos rgyan dkar pos brgyan la sdig pa dang bar chad zhi bar 'dod pa'i bsam pas/ sngar bshams pa'i stan la kha shar du bltas te skyil krung sam pus 'khyud dang bcas pa'i tsog bu rkang pa gnyis cung zad bsnol ba rig byed 'don pa lta bu'i spyod lam gyis 'dug go /dngos gzhi la/ bdag gi rnal 'byor me brtsal yo byad bsang / /thab khung 'dus byas 'jig rten me lha mchod/ /'das pa'i me lha mchod rnams dngos gzhi'i chos/ /zhes pa ltar drug las/ dang po bdag gi rnal 'byor ni/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor dang ma 'brel na sgrub thabs bsdus pa phur chung bzlas pa bsdu ba'i bar rdzogs par bsgom zhing / 'di nas brtsams te sbyin sreg gi cho ga ma grub kyi bar la lag pa gnyis pus mo las phyir mi 'da' ba la bslab bo/ /gnyis pa me brtsal zhing sgrub pa ni/ skabs 'dir ting nge 'dzin gyi me sbar zhing shin tu 'bar bar bsam/ gsum pa thab dang yo byad bsang ba ni/ bsang chu la nang mchod rdo rje'i rtses gtor nas/ oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li hūm̐/ tshindha tshindha hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las shaṃ las byung ba'i dung phor mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i nang du/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i bsang chu dwangs shing thogs pa med pa thab kyi yo byad thams cad kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta sogs 'khyil pa'i sngags nyer gcig bzla/ de nas thab dang yo byad rnams la ku sha'i 'thor yab kyis bsang chu gtor nas 'khyil pa'i sngags dang / swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ las lha rdzas kyi mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ dpal kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu dang /

sreg rdzas rnams kyang gtsang zhing yid du 'ongs pa/ zhi ba'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ badzra a ha ra li hūm̐ nas/ bi pu ra ya hūm̐ gi bar dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ swahās yam shing / oṃ shrī swahās mar/ oṃ dzriṃ swahās 'bru/ oṃ oṃ swahās rdzas thams cad bkru/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swahās rdzas thams cad sbyangs/ bzhi pa thab khung mngon par 'du bya ba ni/ yang thab la bsang chu gtor nas 'khyil pa'i sngags dang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du/ hūm̐ las zhi ba'i thabs khung dkar po zlum po/ rgyar khru gang / zabs su khru phyed/ kha khyer dang mu ran la rdo rjes mtshan zhing / phyi rol stegs bu gru bzhi'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes brgyan pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa bud shing brtsigs pa dang bcas par gyur par bsam/ lnga pa 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ de'i dbus su padma dang nyi ma'i steng du raṃ las bgrang phreng raṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las me lha sku mdog dmar po 'od zer dkar po 'phro zhing 'du ba rwa skyes la bzhon pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas bgrang phreng dang / g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ gsus khyim che ba/ ral pa'i thor gtsug dang sma ra'i ag tshom can/ drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying khar hūm̐/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros te/ shar lho nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang / lag pa gnyis kyi mthe bong gung mo'i rtsa bar bzhag mdzub mo gung mo'i rgyab nas bkab pa dbyug gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing / oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'di nyid du ni gshegs su gsol/ /gzi brjid chen po me yi lha/ /'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa po/

/thugs rjes sems can don mdzad pas/ /'di nyid du ni gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ aknā ye mahā te dzwa sarba karmā pra sa rdha ka mahā bhu ta/ de wa ri ṣi/ de wi dza satwa/ ma gṛ hi twa/ ka ru ṇi ka sarba satt+wa ttha kri twa/ ā hū ti/ ā hū ti/ a hā ra/ asmin santi/ hi to bha wa/ padma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ oṃ aknā ye sa pa ri wa ra arghaṃ nas/ shapda āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badzra a na la mahā bhu ta dzwa la ya/ sarba duṣṭan bhasmin ku ru hūm̐ phaṭ/ tri shyā ho/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes dam la bzhag oṃ badzra yakṣi ni hūm̐ dzaḥ sogs kyis dgug gzhug bya/ slar yang rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ oṃ badzri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ ku sha'i chun po brgyad la bsang chu gtor nas/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de/ /tshangs pa yi yang dag byed yin/ /'dis bdag cag gi bgegs dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs zhi zhing las kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ oṃ badzra sa twa a/ zhes pas ku sha rtse mo g.yas skor du thab kyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du dbul/ de nas sbyin sreg gi gzhung rnams su gong du me sbar bar bshad kyang / spor lde sbar nas thab la g.yas su lan gsum bskor zhing kī la ya brjod/ oṃ badzra dzwa la raṃ zhes pas thab kyi nang gi ting lo sbar zhing / de nas yam shing gzhan dang bcas pas me legs par 'bar du bcug cing /

mar dgang blugs gsum dang dzwa la'i sngags kyis me gso/ de nas me lha'i lce hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang / dgang blugs kyi kha la raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ oṃ agna ye swāhā/ oṃ agnā ya di bya di bya bi shuddhe mahā shrī ye/ ha bya ka bya ba ha na ya/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chag sngags lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad shintaṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis byon zan dbul/ dgang blugs kha sbyar la thab la lan gsum bskor zhing / oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wa ra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ pā dyaṃ nas shapda'i bar gyis phyi mchod/ nang mchod mtheb srin gyis gtor la/ oṃ agnā ye sa pa ri wa ra oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur ba/ /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'jig byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /ces pas bstod/ skabs 'dir me'i bkra brtag pa ni/ saṃ bu ṭi las 'byung ba'i don kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅges/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan rdo rje dang / /bum pa padma lcags kyu dang / /ku 'dum pa dang g.yas su 'khyil/ /rtse gcig pa ste dbyibs mchog yin/ /rtse gnyis rtse gsum 'bring dang mtha'/ /bskum dang gtsang dang 'ja' tshon dang / /dbang po sbas dang ser dang dkar/ /bai ḍūrya rnams mdog bzang yin/ /dang ba'i sku dang bung ba'i sgra/ /zab cing snyan pa'i sgra ni bzang / /mdor na yid du 'ongs pa yi/ /dbyibs dang dri dang sgra rnams bzang / /me stag rnam 'phro du ba mang / /rim gyis 'bar zhing me lce 'chad/ /myur du 'bar zhing gzi brjid chung / /tsha zhing dmar nag drag tu 'bar/ /rtse gsum zhib ma 'dra ba dang / /ba glang mgo 'dra dri mi zhim/ /mdor na yid du mi 'ongs pa/ /mtshan ngan rnams kyang brtag par bya/ /zhi la dkar la rgyas la ser/ /dbang la dmar dang drag la nag /'di ni rang rang rtags su bzang / /'jam po gsum la 'jam po yi/

/rtags rnams shis par bshad pa ste/ /mtha' ma'i las la ngan par sngags/ /rang rang rtags dang mi mthun na/ /bgegs dang bcas par shes bya ste/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil ba la sogs pa'i/ /khro bos bgegs rnams zhi bar bya/ /mdor bsdu na kha dog dkar zhing snum pa sgra dang bcas pa du ba chung ba ni zhi ba'i las la dge'o/ /du ba che ba me stag bar du 'phro ba ni bgegs dang bcas pa yin pas/ hūm̐ zhes brjod cing bsang chu phyogs kun tu gtor te bgegs zhi bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas sreg rdzas dbul ba ni/ thog mar yam shing byang chub kyi shing du mos te/ oṃ bodhi bṛkṣa ya swāhā/ zhes pa bdun gyis phul ba'i mthar/ oṃ bodhi bṛkṣa ya/ bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dang / gsang sngags kyi lhag chad la sogs pa'i nyes pa thams cad shintaṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes brjod/ de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la yang de'i rigs pas shes par byas la/ oṃ agnā ye swahā/ zhes pas mar dang / oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra ye swahā/ zhes pas til lam yungs kar dang / oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swahās zho dang sbyar ba'i zas mchog dang / oṃ badzra bi dza ya swahās 'bras so ba dang / oṃ badzra puṣṭa ye swahās 'bras dang / oṃ mahā bhe ga ya swahās nas dang / oṃ badzra ghasma rā ya swahās gro dang / oṃ mahā bā la ya swahās sran ma dang / oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe swahās dur ba dang / oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzra ya swahās ku sha rnams phul la/ sde tshan re re'i mthar gong ltar gyi spel tshig sbyar ro/ /der bsang chu nas me nang du cung zad blugs la/ oṃ prokṣa ni añtsa ma naṃ pra titstsha swahā/ zhes pas bsang gtor dang zhabs bsil phul/ mar blug gzar gang thab nang du blugs la/ oṃ badzra dzwa la raṃ/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam/ drug pa 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ slar me gso ba'i phyir bud shing brtsigs pa dang /

mchod pa sreg rdzas rnams kha cung zad kha gsos la 'khyil pa'i sngags dang / oṃ mahā shun+yā ta sogs dang / oṃ dharmā dha tu sogs kyis me dang thab bsangs sbyangs/ rdo rje khro bos zhe sdang gcod/ /sogs nas/ ma traṃ dza'i bar sgrub thabs rgyas pa bzhin dang / gdan de rnams kyi steng du hūm̐ sgril ma bcu gcig dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rnams las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs su gyur pa ni/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sogs dang / dbus su dpal chen khro bo'i rgyal/ /nas/ me phung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs/ /oṃ dipta sogs dang / yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs nas/ /yab kyi g.yon nas 'khyud pas bzhugs/ /oṃ badzra kro dha hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐/ sogs nas/ dam can dbang phyug ma bskyed pa'i bar lha sta gon gyi skabs ji lta ba bzhin dam tshig pa bskyed/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ spro na spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ dmigs med mkha' ltar dag cing khyab pa yi/ /chos sku nam mkha' lta bur dbyer med kyang / /thabs dang shes rab gzugs brnyan skur ston pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /zhes dang / ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gi mthar/ oṃ badzra yakṣi ni hūm̐ dzaḥ sogs kyis ye shes pa bcug lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying khar hūm̐/ de rnams las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje 'bru gsum gyi rnam par byung ba gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ka ya wakka tsitta badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ thabs kyi spyod pas/ sogs kyis dbang bskur/ gtso 'khor gzhan thams cad la khro bo rigs lnga dang / dam can dbang phyug ma rnams la rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa phyed pa res dbur brgyan/

de nas byon zan dbul ba ni/ kī la ya'i rjes su/ agnā ye sogs spel tshig dang bcas pa lan bdun dbul/ slar yang mchod rdzas dang sreg rdzas rnams gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ sgeg phreng sogs phyi mchod dang / rang byung gdod nas dag pa sogs dang / rgyal ba kun dngos sogs kyi nang mchod/ 'khril pa'i mchod chen sogs kyis gsang mchod/ nyams pa'i sgrub rdzas sogs kyis de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa/ dam tshig chen po sogs gdab kha dang pos bsgral mchod dang / he ru ka yi gnas bcu dang / /sogs rakta'i mchod pa dang / nga ni za byed chen po sogs khams gsum yongs bsgral gyi mchod pa/ bla med mchog sogs gtor ma'i mchod pa/ sgeg cing dpa' dang sogs bstod pa bsnyen sgrub gsal byed bzhin bya'o/ /de nas sreg rdzas 'bul ba'i go rim gong bzhin la/ sngags rnams kī la ya 'ba' zhig gis dbul/ bsnyen pa kha gso'i skabs su/ til lam yungs kar gang rung la bcu cha'i grangs 'dzin zhing spel tshig gong ltar bya/ skabs skabs su me gso ba'i phyir yam shing dang mar ji ltar rigs pa dbul/ sreg rdzas gzhan rnams brgya rtsa res dbul dgos pa/ dus gcig la phul na me mi 'bar ba'i skyon yong bas skabs su gang bab res 'bul/ mthar mar gyis gang ba'i sbyin sreg lan bdun sngags spel tshig gong ltar bya/ de nas phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ bstod pa'i mchod pa rnams gong du bshad pa bzhin dang / yi dam chos skyong gzhan la'ang so so'i gtor chog bzhin 'bul/ de nas ye shes lnga ldan sogs kyis 'dod don gsol/ yi ge brgya pa tshar gsum dang / ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /sogs kyis thabs kyi ye shes pa gshegs dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis thal ba blangs la dpral bar reg go /gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga ni/ me lha lhag mas mchod dang gtor ma btang /

/'dod don zhus la gshegs gsol lhag chad bskang / /las kyi rjes bsdu ba ste drug yin no/ /zhes pa ltar las/ dang po me lha mchod pa ni/ thab khung du mar blug gzar gang dgang gzar la reg pa dang bcas pas blugs la/ oṃ badzra dzwa la raṃ/ zhes brjod de/ me lha zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa'i sku can du gyur par bsam/ de nas sreg rdzas lhag ma rnams so so'i sngags spel tshig dang bcas pa bdun res dbul/ slar yang mar gyis gang ba'i sbyin sreg lan bdun phul la mchod bstod gong bzhin bya'o/ /gnyis pa gtor ma btang ba ni/ me lha 'khor bcas la gtor ma nang mchod chu chang gis bran/ 'khyil pas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ agnā ye sa pā ri wā ra a ka ro btags pa lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul la/ oṃ aghā ye sa pā ri wā ra sngon du 'gro ba'i phyi mchod/ nang mchod gong bzhin dang / bstod pa ni/ 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs kyi mthar/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs su skyobs pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis skur sprul pa/ /rigs sngags grub pa'i drang srong tshul/ /nyon mongs sreg pa'i shes rab 'od/ /bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan/ /thabs kyi sprul pa'i theg pa chibs/ /rigs sngags gsung gi bgrang phreng 'dzin/ /bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan ghuṇḍe bsnams/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la bsil/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod/ /'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'da'/ /zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che/ /de bas bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /zhes pas bstod/ gsum pa 'dod don zhu ba ni/ drang srong chen po 'khor bcas rnams/

/mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pa'i bar gyis 'dod don gsol ba'o/ /bzhi pa gshegs su gsol ba ni/ oṃ krokṣa ni añtsa ma naṃ pā dyaṃ pra titstsha swahās bsang gtor dang zhabs bsil phul/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /byin za khyod kyis sgrub kyis gshegs/ /ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te/ /bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs/ /oṃ agnā ye ya hi gatstsha zhes dang / dbyug gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya phyir bskyed de/ me lha rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam mo/ /lnga pa lhag chad kha bskang ba ni/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskangs/ oṃ shrī badzra ku ma ra sogs kyis go cha bgo ba dang rtag chad kyi mtha' bsal/ bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis sogs sgrub thabs bzhin bya'o/ /drug pa las kyi rjes bsdu ba ni/ 'di lta bu'i sbyin sreg gi dus 'dir me'i dkyil mi dkrug phus mi gdab/ me ma shi bar g.yo 'gul mi byed/ bud shing yam shing sogs sreg rdzas rnams la mi 'gom/ me lha drang srong yin pas gtsang sbra la gnas par bya'o/ /'di'i ngag 'don kha skong dgos pa rje bla ma dam pas mdzad pa'i sgrub dkyil du shes par bya'o/ /'di lta bu'i sbyin sreg gi skabs/ zhag grangs du dgos dang / sngags kyi grangs/ sreg rdzas 'bul lugs sogs kyi phyag len ni zhag bdun gyi bar du mdzad pa'i/ nub dang po nyi ma phyed yol la tshugs pa'i do nub sngags khri tsho gcig bzla zhing / 'das pa'i me lha'i sreg rdzas rnams bcu gcig pa thengs bcu gcig gis 'bul dgos pa'i thog mtha' gnyis la rdzas sngags so sos phul/ bar gyi tshan pa dgu po kī la ya 'ba' zhig gis 'bul la/ sngags stong phrag re'i mtshams su 'bul thengs re mdzad cing / dpon slob mang po yod na mchod pa gtor bsngo sogs la rol chen mdzad cing /

gtor bsngo rgyas pa'i gtor 'bul gyi skabs rol mo chems brdung mdzad de/ do nub dgong mo thun gcig sang de nas bzung ste nyi ma drug po la nyin re la sngags khri tsho phyed dang gsum re bzla zhing / snga dro shar skya la tshugs pa mdzad de/ 'das pa'i me lha'i sreg rdzas 'bul lugs rnams gong bzhin la/ sngags stong phrag gnyis re'i mtshams su 'bul thengs re re byas pa bdun dang / sngags stong phrag re'i rjes su sreg rdzas 'bul thengs re re byas pa gsum ste yongs sgril sngags khri phrag gcig dang stong phrag bdun bzla/ de nas dkar bdud phur srung gi gtor bsngo sogs dang mjug chog byas te snga thun grol mtshams gsol ba mdzad/ de nas dgong thun btsugs pa'i sreg rdzas rnams 'bul lugs gong bzhin la/ sngags brgyad brgya re'i mtshams su 'bul thengs re re byas pa lan grangs bcu 'bul ba ste yongs dril sngags stong phrag brgyad bzla/ gtor bsngo rgyas pa sogs mjug chog byas te/ phyag len la thun gnyis ma mdzad/ grol ba'i snga dro gong bzhin sngags khri phrag gcig bzlas pas kha gso'i grangs lhag tsam 'gro zhing / gtor bsngo rgyas pa dang bkra shis rgyas par bya'o/ /gong gi bsnyen pa kha gso'i skabs su til lam yungs kar gang rung la bcu cha'i grangs 'dzin par gsungs pa'i phyag len ni/ rang nyid gcig pus sbyin sreg byed na lag pa g.yon pas sngags kyi grangs phreng ba la 'dzin zhing / g.yas pas til lam yungs kar blug pas snod che ba zhig nas mtheb srin gyis til sogs blangs te/ rang gi pang du snod chung ba zhig gi nang du sngags bzla bar la dal bus bsags nas/ sreg rdzas tshan pa gzhan rnams 'bul ran byung re bzhin/ thog mar pang du bsags pa'i yungs kar til gang rung de sngags sogs gang yang mi brjod pa me nang du 'bul bar mdzad cing / de nas sreg rdzas so so rdzas sngags sogs dang bstun te 'bul bar mdzad pas/

bcu cha'i grangs 'dzin dngos ni phreng ba rang la nges par mdzad pas de bzhin du go dgos shing / yang sbyin sreg pa dpon slob mang po yod tshe gtso bo des g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis til lam yungs kar snod che ba nas chung bar bsog tshul sogs gong du bshad pa ltar dang / sgrub grogs rnams kyi grangs phreng ba kho na la zin chog pa phyag len 'khrul med yin no// ༈ //de ltar lha mchog rdo rje gzhon nu yi/ /sbyin sreg cho ga sngon med ngo mtshar gtam/ /don gnyer rnams la yid bzhin nor bu ltar/ /dgos 'dod kun 'byung 'di yi byed po ni/ /'khon gyi rigs skyes sngags 'chang sa skya pa/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes bya bas/ /sbyar ba'i dge bas bdag dang gdul bya yis/ /'di phyi'i don kun yid bzhin legs 'grub ste/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i chos srid dpal 'byor dang / /de rgyun 'dzin pa'i gdung rigs dri med sogs/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel zhing rab rgyas nas/ /sngags 'chang yab sras bstan 'di dar bar shog /ces pa 'di yang snyigs dus kyi bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi thugs sras rgyal tshab dam pa lha mchog rdo rje gzhon nu nyid ngur smrig gi na bza' dang / gos dkar lcang los mdzes pa'i skur sprul pa'i 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched zhal rnam pa gnyis dang / rje btsun mus pa chen po/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa sogs yongs 'dzin du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa/ 'khon ston rdo rje 'dzin pa ā nandas/ rigs kyi bu ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug rdo rje phur pa'i bsnyen pa gegs med du mthar phyin te sbyin sreg byed par nye ba na/ sngon rang lo bcu bzhi lon dus bde mchog pho brang du/ yab rje chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs drung nyid du rdo rje phur pa'i bsnyen pa dang sbyin sreg bgyis skabs kyi phyag len ji ltar mdzad pa blo la zin pa rnams gsal byed kyi rgyan dam par bkod cing /

rtsa ba'i yi ge sa lo chen pos mdzad pa'i sbyin sreg rdo rje'i me 'od kyi dgongs pa bzhin sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sa skyar skyes shing yi ge'i 'du byed la mkhas pa nor bu lha sbyin gyis bgyis so/ /bstan bcos 'di ni rdo rje phur pa yi/ /bstan srung dkar bdud lcam dral khyed la gtad/ /'di sogs rdo rje phur pa'i bstan pa'i rgyun/ /phyogs 'dir mi nub dar rgyas rtag brtan mdzod/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 12 a myes zhabs/ dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i sbyin sreg gi phyag len rab tu gsal ba 'phrin las lhun grub/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
